README.md: Project guide: setup, architecture, simulated vs live AI, the AI Headquarters wing and how each test maps to the brief.
index.html: Vite HTML entry page. Loads the fonts and mounts the React app on #root.
package.json: npm scripts (dev, build, single-file build, tests) and the app's dependencies.
tsconfig.json: TypeScript compiler settings for the app and tests.
vite.config.ts: Vite build config, including the single-file standalone build.
src/App.tsx: App shell. Lays out the top bar, toolbar, viewport and side panels, runs the simulation loop and shows the conflict dialog.
src/main.tsx: Browser entry point. Mounts <App/> and loads the global stylesheet.
src/characters/color.ts: Colour helper that lightens or darkens a hex colour for character shading.
src/engine/geometry.ts: Grid geometry helpers: cell keys, rectangles, door positions on walls, room centres and polylines.
src/model/alertDefaults.ts: Built-in alarm sounds and default alert settings per severity.
src/model/defaults.ts: Factories for new rooms, furniture, agents, outfits and room templates, plus default appearance values.
src/ui/AgentPanel.tsx: Agent list panel: search, add, duplicate, power and delete agents.
src/ui/AppearanceEditor.tsx: Character appearance editor with presets, skin tones and a live multi-view preview.
src/ui/Console.tsx: AI command console. Sends plain-English commands to the provider and previews the resulting operations before Apply.
src/ui/Dashboard.tsx: Office dashboard: agent status counts, task activity and AI provider status.
src/ui/Inspector.tsx: Inspector for the selected room, door, hallway, object or agent, with fixes for validation issues.
src/ui/ProfileDrawer.tsx: Agent profile drawer: identity, personality, skills, permissions, memory and export.
src/ui/Settings.tsx: App settings: AI provider, theme and behaviour toggles.
src/ui/Toolbar.tsx: Build toolbar: tools for rooms, doors, hallways and objects, plus align and distribute actions.
src/ui/TopBar.tsx: Top bar: save, open, import/export, versions, undo/redo and simulation play/pause.
src/ui/actions.ts: Shared UI actions (delete, duplicate, keyboard shortcuts) that go through the store.
src/ui/primitives.tsx: Reusable form controls and dialogs: text, number, colour, select, toggle, chips and confirm.
src/viewport/AgentsLayer.tsx: Draws agents and travelling tube capsules on the office canvas.
src/viewport/ContextMenu.tsx: Right-click menu on the viewport for quick add, duplicate and delete.
src/viewport/Minimap.tsx: Minimap of the whole office with the current camera window.
tests/smoke.test.ts: Smoke test: the sample office builds with every hallway connected and no validation issues.
